name: page-as-context
description: Read filtered context and perform explicitly authorized actions in a connected Chrome or Firefox tab.
long_description: Private macOS Apple silicon desktop extension. Select chrome or firefox in configuration, then ask Claude to set up that browser. Review local setup changes, compare the pairing code in the extension and approve there. Connect each source tab explicitly. Browser action approvals and privacy filters remain active. Includes its Node runtime; no terminal or separate setup app is needed.

browser.title: Browser: chrome or firefox
browser.description: Enter exactly chrome or firefox. Only this browser is exposed. After changing it, restart this extension and reconnect the tab. Each browser uses a separate Claude profile.
